Symptom: the update service does not start

Run sc query wuauserv. A healthy service reports:

SERVICE_NAME: wuauserv
DISPLAY_NAME: Windows Update
        TYPE               : 20  WIN32_SHARE_PROCESS
        STATE              : 4  RUNNING
                                (STOPPABLE, NOT_PAUSABLE, ACCEPTS_PRESHUTDOWN)
        WIN32_EXIT_CODE    : 0  (0x0)
        SERVICE_EXIT_CODE  : 0  (0x0)
        CHECKPOINT         : 0x0
        WAIT_HINT          : 0x0

If STATE shows 1 STOPPED and WIN32_EXIT_CODE is not 0, look the code up
with net helpmsg. Use sc queryex to see the PID as well.
